title: [maintainer] create-objectstack: the blank template's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` is 85 lines, 66 of them peer-dependency commentary — the third-largest file in a "clean slate" project; keep the file minimal and move the rationale out
body:
Filing gate: ③ task dispatched by the maintainer, quoted verbatim below; measurements class (a), this session.
reach: `npm create objectstack@latest my-app` (17.7.0) writes `pnpm-workspace.yaml` at 4,700 bytes: 85 lines, 66 comment lines, 5 blank, 14 lines of configuration. By size it is the third file in the project after README.md (6,491) and AGENTS.md (5,514), ahead of `objectstack.config.ts` (4,032).
Reader: `domain:cli` seat (`packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/pnpm-workspace.yaml`; `os init` renders the same file).
Dedup: `search_issues` "blank template pnpm-workspace.yaml long comments peerDependencyRules scaffold minimal file" → 5 hits, all closed; #17093 is the only one about this file (a retired comment that no gate reads — it shows the commentary already drifts); none asks for the file to shrink.
Filed on the maintainer's instruction in this session (category ③, quoted verbatim): 「空白模板的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 有约 90 行 peer-dependency 考据注释。 对"clean slate"项目来说这是第一眼看到的最长文件。建议文件保持最小,理由搬到文档或脚手架源码注释。」

## What the newcomer opens

The scaffolded project's README calls itself "a clean slate for building". The workspace file they open beside it explains, over 66 comment lines: which pnpm versions parse `packages:` before `engines`; why `allowBuilds` and `onlyBuiltDependencies` are both needed and which pnpm versions read which; a behavioural measurement of better-auth on better-sqlite3 13 vs 12 ("Re-measured on the pinned 1.7.2 and now structural…"); a retired `@better-auth/scim>better-call` entry and the date it retired; four `@better-auth/*>@better-auth/utils` skews and the pnpm version at which they self-resolve. All of it is true, none of it is the newcomer's decision, and #17093 showed it drifts because no gate reads it.

## Asked for

Keep the 14 configuration lines, each with at most one comment line naming its reason, e.g.:

```yaml
packages: []            # settings-only; this project is not a workspace root

allowBuilds:            # native/prebuilt installs pnpm must be allowed to run
  better-sqlite3: true
  esbuild: true
onlyBuiltDependencies:  # same list, for pnpm < 10.26
  - better-sqlite3
  - esbuild

peerDependencyRules:    # declared-vs-resolved peer skews measured harmless; see <docs page>
  allowedVersions:
    'better-auth>better-sqlite3': '13'
    …
```

The measurements and version-history move to where they are maintained: the scaffolder source (`template-consistency.test.ts` / `pkg-utils.ts` already own the version pins) or a short docs page the comment links to. The two consistency tests keep asserting the configuration, which is all they assert today.
